Samuel — thanks, glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a DPA and subprocessors list; we support transfers under SCCs and have a private deployment option if you need data residency. For SOC 2 and the pen test summary we have redacted/high-level artifacts we can share under mutual NDA, and we can accommodate limited audit rights (read-only evidence review + onsite remote review) for enterprise contracts.

I attached our redline-ready DPA (RNW_DPA_redlines_v2.docx) with two items I anticipate will come up:
- Audit clause: we propose a timeboxed review process (30-day notice + read-only evidence) rather than open-ended onsite audits.
- Subprocessors: we list current providers and a 30-day notice for additions; customer approval is only required for 3rd-party infra changes impacting EU data transfer flows.

Samuel — I'll start a short internal loop to confirm the DocuSign flow and whether Legal is OK to share the pen-test highlights PDF. Laura / Karthik — can you review the attached and suggest language if VitaNova presses for broader audit rights or an ATP (audit/troubleshooting privilege)?

Suggested edits for audit clause (high level):
- Customer audit rights: limited to documentation review and remote evidence access for SOC 2 Type II artifacts; any onsite or vendor-penetration testing requests require 45 days' notice and are scoped separately.
- For PHI work: require Data Processing Addendum + encryption-at-rest + customer-managed keys for Private deployment; we can offer a Managed Dedicated instance if VitaNova needs more control.

Playbook for procurement:
1) Send updated DPA with tracked changes (RNW_DPA_redlines_v2.docx).
2) Offer to execute via DocuSign and attach SOC 2 summary via secure drive link; pen-test highlights to be shared after a mutual NDA is signed.
3) If they request broader audit rights, propose a targeted inspection window (up to 4 hours remote session) rather than open-ended onsite access.

I recommend we pre-authorize the DocuSign envelope once we get a PO/LOI.

Adding specific redline text snippets you can paste into the DPA: 
1) Audit rights: 
"Customer shall have the right, upon thirty (30) days prior written notice, to conduct a remote review of Provider's SOC 2 Type II report and associated evidence. Any request for onsite audit or penetration testing shall be subject to Provider's reasonable security and operational constraints and may require additional execution of a separate audit scope agreement."

2) Subprocessors: add clause: "Provider shall maintain a current list of subprocessors and provide Customer with written notice of any material changes at least thirty (30) days prior to such change. For changes that introduce cross-border transfers, Provider will offer Customer a compatibility option (SCCs or Private deployment)."

I've attached the SOC 2 summary and the pen test highlights for VitaNova to review (see attachments). Laura — if you want a slightly stronger audit carve-out (e.g., defense in depth language), we can add that, but the customer usually accepts remote review + limited inspection window.

— Karthik
